## Outcome

Describe the reader's problem and resulting behavior. State the milestone and affected platform/formats/providers.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable outcome
- [ ] Persistence, offline, accessibility, and provider constraints where relevant

## Dependencies and architecture

Link prerequisite issues and applicable ADRs. Distinguish committed provider support from feasibility research.

## Validation and handoff

Identify meaningful automated checks and physical/server acceptance. Record branch, exact SHA, relevant results, unverified limits, and next action when handing off. Follow AGENTS.md. Never include private library data, credentials, endpoints, or raw traces.
